scope: Focused regression tests for danmaku layout/overlay, player progress geometry/bar, and ImageViewer interaction cleanup.
command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/danmakuLayout.spec.ts tests/danmakuOverlay.spec.tsx tests/playerProgressGeometry.spec.ts tests/playerProgressBar.spec.tsx tests/ImageViewer.spec.tsx

runtime.packageSource: Existing pnpm content-addressable store; offline extraction

environmentRecovery.cause: The existing node_modules/happy-dom installation declared lib/index.js as its entrypoint but that file was absent, so Vitest could not initialize three DOM test files.
environmentRecovery.resolution: Installed the locked package into an isolated temporary project from the local pnpm store with network disabled, then restored the missing package contents in the project dependency directory.

remaining: Actual rendered danmaku trail behavior across DPR/fullscreen/toggle states remains part of V03 visual acceptance.
The focused tests do not prove every DOM adapter boundary is fully decoupled.
